Deployment: Before setting up ships, starting with the first player, place Sea Monster templates face down anywhere on the seascape.

Summoning: During the Battle Phase you may attempt to summon a Sea Monster instead of activating a ship. Roll a die, on a 4+ the Sea Monster is summoned within the bounds of the template and may act. You may adjust the summon roll by your Wizard's casting modifier.

Sea Monster Reaction Table: If you roll a double during a Sea Monster's movement, look up the double: 1: Un-summon the Sea Monster, opponent places template 2" from any ship, a Sea Monster heals one wound each turn it's not on the seascape; 2: Sea Monster frenzies, move toward nearest friendly vessel and, if reached, attack it; 3-5: No effect; 6: Move twice or attack twice this turn.

Diving: Start of turn a Sea Monster may dive. Choose a target, the Sea Monster is submerged and moves straight toward the target. While submerged the Sea Monster is immune to all attacks, but may also not attack. At the start of it's next move, the Sea Monster surfaces and may not dive again that turn.

Attacks: Sea Monsters make a special attack followed by a boarding action.

Sea Monsters in Combat: If a Sea Monster is in combat and is targeted by another ship, roll a die, on a 1-3 the attacks are made against the ship in combat with the Sea Monster. In addition, spells cast against the Sea Monster also affect the entangled ship.

Against Flyers: Sea Monster's defensive fire is equal to it's wounds, a Sea Monster wounded by a Flyer immediately dives.
